data.body: Root cause reproduced: the probe's expected directory was REPO_ROOT/src/rebar/reconciler, valid only for editable installs; non-editable venv (uv pip install '.[dev]') failed both test_engine_dir probes, editable passed. Fix anchors on Path(rebar.__file__).parent. RED: new relocated-package test failed in the editable .venv with the CI message; GREEN: editable 14 passed (test_engine_dir + test_test_suite_store_isolation), non-editable test_engine_dir 8 passed. make lint and make typecheck exit 0. Pushed as Gerrit change 3268 (sha 94ee4ed65e954fd71cd2f03eaccb50b5ff019467). Filed vegetarian-rainy-darwinsfox (macOS review-bot lifespan failures) and frouzy-downfallen-salamander (shellcheck lints .rebar/scratch).
